bread_carrier.villager_woman_1/greet_1.m.text: Bread's still warm, if you're quick.

bread_carrier.villager_woman_1/greet_2.m.text: Reapers'll riot if this ale's late. Out of my way, dear.

bread_carrier.villager_woman_1/rumour_1..text: The reapers won't work the far field any more. They say the crows won't land there either.

ebb.villager_man_2/greet_1.mp3.text: Hmph. Counted them three times. Still two short.

ebb.villager_man_2/greet_2.mp3.text: Wolves don't leave tracks like that, lad. Nothing I've seen does.

ebb.villager_man_2/greet_3.mp3.text: Stay off the tor after dark. My father said so, and his father before him.

ebb.villager_man_2/rumour_1.mp3.text: Two heifers gone from the high pasture. Footprints by the wall, big as a cartwheel. You go and look, if you've the stomach.

ebb.villager_man_2/startled_1.mp3.text: Steady! You'll scatter the lot of them.

ebb.villager_man_2/startled_2.mp3.text: Not near the beasts, lad. Not near the beasts.

hester.villager_woman_2/greet_1.mp3.text: Sit, sit. You'll be wanting to know about the hanging. Everyone does, eventually.

hester.villager_woman_2/greet_2.mp3.text: That's the knight who broke the Crown. See the sea behind him, and the mist? My grandmother said the cloth was older than the village.

hester.villager_woman_2/greet_3.mp3.text: The Watch wears through tabards faster than I can weave them. Green dye doesn't grow on trees, you know.

hester.villager_woman_2/rumour_1.mp3.text: A panel's missing from the hanging. The last one. Nobody remembers what was on it, and I've asked everyone old enough to know.

hester.villager_woman_2/startled_1.mp3.text: Not near the loom! Do you know how long that took?

hester.villager_woman_2/startled_2.mp3.text: Put that away this instant, Rowan Fenhallow.

jory.villager_man_1/greet_1.mp3.text: Salt, pepper, good Hollin cloth. Last of it, so the price is what it is.

jory.villager_man_1/greet_2.mp3.text: Two wagons I'm owed. The coast road's gone quiet, and nobody'll say why.

jory.villager_man_1/greet_3.mp3.text: If you're ever down Saltmere way, ask after my brother. He'll stand you a drink.

jory.villager_man_1/rumour_1.mp3.text: My last wagon left the coast a fortnight ago. If you're on the south road, keep an eye out for a blue canvas. Goblins have been busy.

jory.villager_man_1/startled_1.mp3.text: Careful! That's my stock you're swinging at!

jory.villager_man_1/startled_2.mp3.text: Easy, easy. Breakages are paid for.

maud.maud/greet_1.mp3.text: Come here, dearie. Lavender for sleep? Everyone's buying it this month.

maud.maud/greet_2.mp3.text: The Fletcher boy walks in his sleep now. Out to the burying ground and back. His mother ties his ankle to the bedpost.

maud.maud/greet_3.mp3.text: Honey, herbs, a charm for luck. You look like you could use all three.

maud.maud/rumour_1.mp3.text: Lights on Brack Tor again. Green ones. I'm only saying.

maud.maud/rumour_2.mp3.text: There's an old man in the house on the hill who hasn't aged a day since I was a girl. Keep away from his gate, dearie.

maud.maud/startled_1.mp3.text: Mind my jars, you clumsy thing!

maud.maud/startled_2.mp3.text: Gracious! At my age, a fright like that could finish me.

nell.villager_woman_1/greet_1.mp3.text: You look like you slept in the hayloft. Again.

nell.villager_woman_1/greet_2.mp3.text: Daisy won't give a drop this morning. She keeps staring at the burying ground.

nell.villager_woman_1/greet_3.mp3.text: Do you ever dream about ships? Black ones, sailing on the clouds? ...Never mind.

nell.villager_woman_1/rumour_1.mp3.text: There's scraping behind the barn walls at night. Rats, Oswin says. Rats don't sound like that.

nell.villager_woman_1/startled_1.mp3.text: Rowan! You'll sour the milk swinging that about!

nell.villager_woman_1/startled_2.mp3.text: Oh! You great oaf, you nearly had my bucket over.

oswin.oswin/greet_1.mp3.text: Fence first, breakfast after. Same as every day.

oswin.oswin/greet_2.mp3.text: That sword stays over the hearth. Your grandfather never could put an edge on it, and neither will you.

oswin.oswin/greet_3.mp3.text: Shut the gate behind you. I mean it.

oswin.oswin/rumour_1.mp3.text: Something's been at the tallow in the cellar. Big, by the look of the teeth marks. Have a look, would you?

oswin.oswin/startled_1.mp3.text: Watch it! I've only the one good back left.

oswin.oswin/startled_2.mp3.text: Put that down before you take my ear off.

pilgrims.villager_man_1/greet_1.mp3.text: Off to the waystone to pray for the harvest. Walk with us a while, if you like.

pilgrims.villager_man_1/greet_2.mp3.text: Blessings on you. The old stones still listen, whatever folk say.

pilgrims.villager_man_1/rumour_1.mp3.text: The waystone was warm to the touch last time. Warm, at midnight. Make of that what you will.

pilgrims.villager_woman_1/greet_1.mp3.text: Off to the waystone to pray for the harvest. Walk with us a while, if you like.

pilgrims.villager_woman_1/greet_2.mp3.text: Blessings on you. The old stones still listen, whatever folk say.

pilgrims.villager_woman_1/rumour_1.mp3.text: The waystone was warm to the touch last time. Warm, at midnight. Make of that what you will.

tam.villager_man_3/greet_1.mp3.text: Can't sharpen that for you. Gerda does the fine work, and Gerda's not here.

tam.villager_man_3/greet_2.mp3.text: Captain Thorne wants forty spearheads by midsummer. Forty! With what iron?

tam.villager_man_3/greet_3.mp3.text: Ha! Mind the anvil, it bites.

tam.villager_man_3/rumour_1.mp3.text: Gerda went down the south road for iron three weeks back. Her cart never came home. I'd go myself, but somebody's got to keep the fire in.

tam.villager_man_3/startled_1.mp3.text: Whoa there! Save it for the goblins.

tam.villager_man_3/startled_2.mp3.text: Ha! Not bad. Now point it somewhere else.

tinker.villager_man_1/greet_1.mp3.text: Pots mended, knives ground, gossip free of charge.

tinker.villager_man_1/greet_2.mp3.text: Every farm on this lane owes me a supper. Good living, tinkering.

tinker.villager_man_1/rumour_1.mp3.text: I've a scrap of old map, shows a tower in the Wolfwood nobody goes near. Yours for a few coins, if you're curious.

villager_man.villager_man_1/greet_1.mp3.text: Morning. Mind the mud by the well, it's deeper than it looks.

villager_man.villager_man_1/greet_2.mp3.text: Fine day for it. Shame about the wolves.

villager_man.villager_man_1/greet_3.mp3.text: Barley's come in early this year. First good news in a while.

villager_man.villager_man_1/rumour_1.mp3.text: Goblins up past the east fields again. Took a whole fence for firewood, the cheek of them.

villager_woman.villager_woman_1/greet_1..text: Oh, it's you! Mind the geese, they've taken against strangers this week.

villager_woman.villager_woman_1/greet_2..text: If you're going out the north gate, be back before dark.

villager_woman.villager_woman_1/greet_3..text: Good day to you. Off on some adventure, are we?

villager_woman.villager_woman_1/rumour_1.text: The baker swears she saw a man walking on the pond at dawn. On it, mind. Not in it.

villager_woman.villager_woman_1/startled.text: Whoa! Not near me, if you please!

washerwoman.villager_woman_1/greet_1.mp3.text: Washing day, every day. That's my lot.

washerwoman.villager_woman_1/greet_2.mp3.text: If you see Oswin, tell him his shirts are on the hedge.

washerwoman.villager_woman_1/rumour_1.mp.text: Something tangled my sheets at the bottom of the pond yesterday. Pulled, it did. I'm not going in after them.

washerwoman.villager_woman_1/startled_1..text: You'll have me in the pond!

watch_gate.guard_1/greet_2.mp3.text: Wolves on the east road again. Stay on the paths.

watch_gate.guard_1/greet_3.mp3.text: If you see goblins, you come and tell the Watch. Don't play the hero.

watch_gate.guard_1/rumour_1.mp3.text: Corbin went out on the north-west lane two nights ago and hasn't come back. If you go that way, look for him.

watch_gate.guard_1/startled_1.mp3.text: Hey! Put that away before someone gets hurt.

watch_gate.guard_1/startled_2.mp3.text: Easy there! That's the Watch you're swinging at.

watch_gate.guard_1/sword_drawn_1.mp3.text: Keep your blade sheathed inside the fence.

watch_gate.guard_1/sword_drawn_2.mp3.text: Put that away, farmhand. There's nothing here to fight.

watch_gate.guard_2/greet_2.mp3.text: Wolves on the east road again. Stay on the paths.

watch_gate.guard_2/greet_3.mp3.text: If you see goblins, you come and tell the Watch. Don't play the hero.

watch_gate.guard_2/rumour_1.mp3.text: Corbin went out on the north-west lane two nights ago and hasn't come back. If you go that way, look for him.

watch_gate.guard_2/startled_1.mp3.text: Hey! Put that away before someone gets hurt.

watch_gate.guard_2/startled_2.mp3.text: Easy there! That's the Watch you're swinging at.

watch_gate.guard_2/sword_drawn_1.mp3.text: Keep your blade sheathed inside the fence.

watch_gate.guard_2/sword_drawn_2.mp3.text: Put that away, farmhand. There's nothing here to fight.

watch_patrol.guard_1/greet_1.mp3.text: Twice round the fence, she says. Twice! My boots are older than you.

watch_patrol.guard_1/greet_2.mp3.text: Heard the Captain's sent for help from the Wolfwood garrison. Nobody's come.

watch_patrol.guard_1/rumour_1.mp3.text: Captain Thorne's paying for goblin ears and wolf pelts at the Watch house. Easy coin, if you've the stomach.

watch_patrol.guard_1/startled_1.mp3.text: Try that again and you'll spend the night in the stocks.

watch_patrol.guard_2/greet_1.mp3.text: Twice round the fence, she says. Twice! My boots are older than you.

watch_patrol.guard_2/greet_2.mp3.text: Heard the Captain's sent for help from the Wolfwood garrison. Nobody's come.

watch_patrol.guard_2/rumour_1.mp3.text: Captain Thorne's paying for goblin ears and wolf pelts at the Watch house. Easy coin, if you've the stomach.

watch_patrol.guard_2/startled_1.mp3.text: Try that again and you'll spend the night in the stocks.
